title: Ghana Empire recorded
summary: The scholar al-Khwarizmi made the first identifiable written mention of Ghana's ruling dynasty, whose kings were also called 'king of gold'.
why: A Sahel state that grew rich on the trans-Saharan gold and salt trade.

notes.problem: Source: earliest mention of Ghana is a 788-93 Arabic source; 830 is first mention of the dynasty. 'First great empire' unsupported.
'Most powerful Sahel state of its time' is not in the source; it gives the gold/salt monopoly.

superlativeSource: The first identifiable mention of the imperial dynasty in written records
